todos: Finish the greenfield presentation reorganization by adding explicit feature ViewModels, then delete the remaining PageUi helper without compatibility adapters.

Complete PageScaffold by flattening Packages and Updates and migrating every nested mode to it; apply semantic breakpoint tokens and remove the remaining duplicated title grids, padding state blocks, scrolling, footer, and responsive action layouts.

Migrate all remaining manual action bars to typed UiCommand definitions rendered by OnlyWingetCommandBar, including overflow, destructive confirmations, shortcuts, loading and cancel placement; delete string lookup and button enablement code from PageUi and code-behind.

Define presentation models for empty, loading, executing, error, and unavailable-capability states and migrate every feature to StatePresenter with optional actions and expandable technical details; delete StatusText, LoadingStatusText, and ApplyStatus usage.

Connect OperationBanner to preset execution, winget update execution, Windows Update scan/install, and cancellation, including phase, package or update detail, determinate progress where available, final error, and reboot-required state; delete manual progress text composition.

Implement typed table column definitions and OnlyWingetTable so one declaration generates header and cells with shared horizontal scrolling, stable item sources, standard selection and mixed select-all, selectable and truncated text, compact cards, keyboard navigation, UI Automation, High Contrast, and 200% text scaling.

Migrate preset packages, package search, winget updates, Windows Update, and sources to OnlyWingetTable; delete FixedTableLayout, TableColumnLayout, ColumnNWidth resources, and all duplicated header and row column definitions.
Move localization, row transformation, progress formatting, and remaining interaction orchestration out of page code-behind into feature ViewModels and the existing injectable UI services.

Add reusable validated field models and controls for preset names, package IDs, and sources with visible labels, inline messages, duplicate detection, accessible error association, and command enablement derived from validity.

Finish Packages as one responsive workflow with active preset context, preset packages, search, selected packages, operation results, add-to-preset state, multi-selection, import/export actions, install/uninstall preview, destructive confirmation, and package/source validation; remove the nested legacy page composition.

Finish Updates as one responsive workflow with App winget and Windows Update modes, shared scan/apply/cancel commands and filters, coherent tables, per-row failures, operation summary, and reboot-required state while preserving explicit-only Windows Update scans; remove the nested legacy page composition.

Redesign Sources as validated configuration management with coherent rows or cards, enabled and unavailable states, per-row actions, source testing where supported, and previewed confirmed remove/reset operations.

Finish Activity with category filters, localized severity labels, copy detail, export log, richer technical details, and soft-confirmed clear or undo while preserving implemented search, severity filtering, expandable rows, and stable collection updates.

Redesign Home as an operational overview of winget and Windows Update capability, update and error status, active preset, useful metrics, warnings, recent activity, and clear quick actions without triggering implicit Windows Update scans.

Update all visible EN/IT strings, architecture documentation, and UI automation coverage for the final routes and shared components; remove obsolete presentation models, styles, code-behind helpers, dead files, and tests after migration.
After implementation, run Setup only if restore inputs changed, then Format, Lint, Typecheck, Test, and Build through scripts/run.ps1; fix every failure and keep PROJECT_STATUS.json residual-only.

On an interactive Windows desktop after the redesign, verify compact, medium, and wide layouts and vertical and horizontal mouse-wheel behavior over rows, checkboxes, selectable text, headers, and scrollers on every route; assert vertical scroll percentage changes whenever the target is scrollable.

On an interactive Windows desktop after the redesign, complete keyboard-only, visible-focus, Narrator, UI Automation naming, High Contrast, and 200% text-scaling checks for every route and shared component, and fix all failures.

On clean Windows 10 build 17763 and current Windows 11 hosts, validate Windows Update software, driver, Microsoft-product, cancellation during scan and install, malformed-output, COM-failure, partial-failure, and reboot-required flows.

On a disposable Windows host with controlled packages and sources, run destructive live winget install, upgrade, uninstall, cancellation, concurrent-command rejection, progress, localized-output, Unicode, variable-column, and multiple-source smoke tests.

On a clean elevated x64 Windows host, validate the MSI, Burn setup, and self-contained portable ZIP lifecycle, including Windows App Runtime chaining, installed and portable startup, Programs and Features registration, clean install, upgrade, uninstall, and artifact architecture checks.
Run the hosted GitHub Actions build gate for the exact release commit before tagging.
